name: What can go wrong with natural stone tile if it’s installed the wrong way?

mainEntity.name: What can go wrong with natural stone tile if it’s installed the wrong way?

acceptedAnswer.text: The main risks are staining, etching from acids, cracking from movement, and moisture damage if the stone is used in a wet area without proper sealing and waterproofing. Some stones also need gentler cleaners, so the wrong maintenance products can damage the finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Natural stone can stain, etch, crack, or suffer moisture damage if it is not installed and sealed correctly. Using the wrong cleaner can also damage the finish over time.
